primary_reason: The literature does not establish a robust unconditional return beginning after public dissemination and a realistic next-open fill.
independent_rejection_reasons: The only positive short post-event portfolio result is equal-weighted in a legacy sample; the value-weighted counterpart is null.
Long-horizon gains are materially conditioned on future outcomes, especially takeovers.
No natural ex-ante concentrated ranking rule supports a one-slot expression.
The cited studies do not implement acceptance-time dissemination and next-regular-open execution.
implementation_blocks_not_used_as_primar: No local raw Schedule 13D accession corpus or validated Item 4 classifier.
No effective-dated CIK/CUSIP/security-class mapping into canonical lifetimes.
Qualifying-event occupancy cannot be measured from index metadata alone.
